data.title: Sensorion Announces the Completion of Its Reverse Share Split
data.description: Montpellier, France & Cambridge, Massachusetts - Sensorion (FR001401A9Z0 – ALSEN) (“the Company”), a leading clinical-stage biotech firm focusing on innovative treatments for hearing loss disorders, has recently finalized a reverse share split of its shares. The decision was made by the Chief Executive Officer on July 27th, 2026, under sub-delegation from the Board. This strategic move will impact the composition of the Company's share capital and marks a significant development in Sensorion's operations.

data.title: Kitron ASA - Initiation of share buyback program
data.description: On September 15, 2026, Kitron ASA announced the commencement of a share repurchase program. This initiative is part of the company's remuneration plan for its board members. The specific number of shares to be repurchased and the total value of the buyback were not disclosed in the initial announcement. This move indicates Kitron ASA's commitment to rewarding its board members and potentially enhancing shareholder value through the repurchase of company shares.

data.title: Inculab plus' KidsTopia Earns 'kidSAFE SAFE CERTIFIED' Global Child Online Safety Seal
data.description: KidsTopia, based in Korea, has significantly improved its child safety measures, particularly in chat, user reporting, and AI interactions. This initiative has led to KidsTopia being recognized as a distinguished member in this field. The company has taken further steps to enhance its AI safeguards by implementing AI character disclosure and break reminders. This move signifies a strong commitment to ensuring a safer digital environment for children. The development was announced in a joint statement from Los Angeles and Seoul on September 15, 2026, making KidsTopia a pioneer in this effort.

data.title: TrueFoundry Receives Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Global Enterprise AI Control Plane Transformational Innovation Leadership Recognition for Enterprise AI Governance and Operational Excellence
data.description: TrueFoundry has been acknowledged for revolutionizing enterprise AI operations with a consolidated control plane, facilitating secure, governed, observable, and scalable AI deployment. The recognition was announced by Frost & Sullivan in San Antonio on September 15, 2026. TrueFoundry’s innovative approach has garnered significant praise and accolades in the industry.

data.title: Over 120 Full Sail University Graduates Contribute to Winning Projects at the 78th Annual Primetime Emmys
data.description: Three individuals who graduated from Full Sail University have recently been awarded Primetime Emmy Awards. This took place at the 78th annual Primetime Emmy Awards, where a total of 124 Full Sail alumni were recognized for their contributions to 52 winning projects spanning 85 categories.
